supersedes_gate: run_b6_coupled_evans_scan.py FLOOR_TARGET=1e-12 absolute + relative negative control
why_failed: Absolute 1e-12 threshold passed by pure noise when |E| floor ~1e-16..1e-21 (vacuous)
Negative control compared to 100*max(d_ref,1e-18) instead of the MEASURED noise floor
No scaling requirement -> 'small |E|' was treated as evidence of a pole

new_gates.G1_relative_dip: min over rosette |E(w0+delta)| >= 100x |E(w0)| (>= 2 orders), delta = 1e-6..1e-3, both +Re and +Im directions
new_gates.G2_scaling: |E(w0+delta)| ~ C*|delta| with fitted slope 0.8..1.25 (simple zero) and linear regression R^2 >= 0.99 over >= 3 delta decades; higher order zeros need declared order m and slope ~ m
new_gates.G3_absolute_floor: |E(w0)| < 1e-2 * floor_measured(w0), floor_measured = median |E| over rosette at largest delta (never an assumed constant)
new_gates.G4_negative_control_absolute: |E(negctrl)| >= 100x floor_measured(w0) — against the measured floor, not relative to the candidate
new_gates.G5_dps_stability: verdict identical at dps 30 and 50 (control solver), scaling exponent stable within 0.1
new_gates.G6_conditioning: cond(M_match) at w0 reported; sigma_min isolated (gap >= 1e4 to next sigma), no multi-singular-value collapse
new_gates.G7_holomorphy: E evaluated as raw det of analytic M_match (no QR normalization inside the function); incoming-mode selection verified continuous on the rosette

release_rule: ALL of G1-G7 must pass before any candidate may be called GATED_POLE_CANDIDATE; on failure classify REJECTED_<gate>
certified_reference: tools/b6_mpmath_evans_v2.py (raw-det holomorphic Evans, mpmath) — the double-precision QR solver is demoted to coarse-scan only, never certification
